hypothesis: JIT compilation materially increases the current captured projection SELECT latency.
source: Git HEAD at launch; all tracked source hashes frozen by runner before resource creation
fixture: directory/seed_demo + synthetic_load_dataset.populate; unchanged contractual repeated content; sequential fresh fixtures
query: Exact SELECT with AS _pv_check_status captured once from current /es/ projected request; full raw SQL SHA and parameter count/types recorded before paired reads; values stay in memory and are redacted.

modes.B: SET LOCAL jit=off in own READ ONLY transaction

plans: One A and one B EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON), after all SELECT pairs per dataset; separate timers.
equivalence: Full ordered raw values equality for all rows in memory, expected count=N, unchanged captured SQL and parameters. This is SQL equivalence, not a new native validation acceptance.

decision.confirmed_material_select_effect: A jit=on; all four paired select savings >=20%, median absolute saving >=0.25 s. Relative threshold filters small drift; absolute threshold represents material cost against existing 0.8s HTTP SLO, not new SLO.
decision.no_material_select_effect_observed: Every pair within +/-10% and +/-0.05s; limited to warmed observed population.
decision.off_slower_in_all_pairs: Negative absolute saving in all pairs.
decision.inconclusive_or_mixed: Any other valid result; retain uncertainty. Cardinalities classified independently; policy decision must explain both.

resources: Owned synthetic PostgreSQL databases on existing local cluster port55432; own temporary media and encryption key; shared host/cluster documented, no competing test runner. No scale/global PG config/index/cache change.
caches: OS/PG warmed by capture and warmups, not reset. Alternate paired order; no cold-cache or causal overhead claim.
driver: Same psycopg cursor in both modes; auto-prepare disabled symmetrically to prevent prior mode determining a cached plan; original setting restored.
scope: SQL execute plus fetch directly observed; setup outside timers; no HTTP/load capacity inference. No active execution altered.
exit: Two cardinalities terminal, result equality and settings restoration, report reviewed, source hashes and cleanup independently checked; conclude R1 once without blind repeats.
historical_verdicts: Short FAIL and original contractual INVALID preserved; 900s blocked until complete short PASS.
capture_selector: SELECT with annotation AS _pv_check_status AND listings_listing.id AS pk; only scalar projection query, excludes native page hydration
